mnt_characteristics.mantle_mechanics: MNT (Mantle Network) specific mechanics: 1. OP Stack L2: forks Optimism Bedrock, EVM-compatible, same fraud proof architecture as OP. 2. ByBit backing: BitDAO (ByBit's DAO) merged into Mantle (2023). ByBit holds large MNT treasury.    ByBit exchange flows create FR events on Bybit vs HL (venue-specific liquidity). 3. Mantle mETH: Liquid staking protocol for ETH on Mantle L2.    mETH staking yield demand creates recurring FR cycles tied to ETH staking APR. 4. Mantle EcoFund: $200M ecosystem fund → token demand cycles on DeFi/gaming launches. 5. MNT used for gas fees on Mantle network → real utility demand (different from pure governance). 6. ByBit listing: MNT is heavily traded on ByBit (primary venue) which may create    venue-specific FR differentials vs HL (secondary venue). 7. OP Stack but distinct tokenomics: No retroPGF (like OP), no bridge arbitrage (like ARB). 8. Newer listing (HL ~May 2024) → only ~730d FR history available.

If shorter windows also fail: MNT fundamentally correlated with L2 cluster.
